function.name: user_api_UserApi_create_managed_user
function.description: Creates a new managed user in the system with specified attributes. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The unique username for the new user.

email.description: The email address for the new user.

password.description: The password for the new user account.

full_name.description: The full name of the user.

role.description: The role assigned to the user.

is_active.description: Indicates whether the user account is active.

function.name: oidc_api_add_mapping_2
function.description: Adds a mapping between an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider and the client system to enable authentication. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the OIDC provider.

client_id.description: The client identifier issued to the client during the registration process.

client_secret.description: The client secret. It should be kept confidential.

redirect_uris.description: A list of allowed redirect URIs for the client.

grant_types.description: A list of grant types that the client can use. Examples include 'authorization_code' and 'implicit'.

response_types.description: A list of the OAuth 2.0 response types that the client can use. Typically includes 'code' for authorization code flow.

scope.description: A space-delimited list of scopes that the client can request during authentication. Example: 'openid profile email'.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: The requested authentication method for the token endpoint. This method should match one of the client's registered authentication methods.

function.name: ldap_api_LdapApi_add_mapping_1
function.description: Adds a new LDAP mapping entry to the directory service, allowing for the synchronization of user data between systems. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mapping_name.description: The unique name for the LDAP mapping.

source.description: The source object or attribute in the LDAP directory to map from.

destination.description: The destination object or attribute to which the LDAP source will be mapped.

mapping_type.description: The type of the mapping, defining how the synchronization should be handled.

sync_frequency.description: Frequency at which the mapping synchronization occurs, measured in minutes.

function.name: user_api_UserApi_add_team_to_user
function.description: Associates a user with a specified team, allowing them access to team resources. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

username.description: The unique identifier of the user to be added to the team.

team_id.description: The unique identifier of the team to which the user will be added.

function.name: cwe_api_CweApi_get_cwe
function.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) based on its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cwe_id.description: The unique integer identifier of the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) to retrieve. For example, for 'CWE-79', the cwe_id would be 79.
